title: fix(mobile): cronet buffer overflow on compressed thumbnails

target.summary: Reusing byteBuffer across read iterations causes its position to accumulate across reads rather than reflect only the latest read chunk. As a result, b.advance(byteBuffer.position()) double-counts prior bytes on subsequent iterations, corrupting the native buffer offset and causing request.read() to fail with an IllegalArgumentException.
notes: faulty buffer reuse logic that double-counts position and passes a full ByteBuffer
